metadata.title: 3D Tic Tac Toe
metadata.description: A 3×3×3 spatial lift of the source game. Two marks alternate; the first three matching marks on a straight spatial line win. A full board without a winner draws.

participants.name: Local player controlling both alternating marks

variables.name: Board cell: empty, X or O

precondition.expr: state.get('rule:state.winner') == 0 and not state.get('rule:state.draw') and topology.contains('rule:topology.board', param.coordinate) and grid.get('rule:state.board', param.coordinate) == 0

systems.name: Detect three matching marks on a straight spatial line
Detect a full volume without a winner
Alternate marks unless the game ended

goals.name: Complete three of your marks on a straight line through the volume

invariants.name: Current mark is X or O

behavior_tests.name: A legal move alternates the mark; an occupied cell rejects the next move
A line through three depth layers wins and closes gameplay

assumptions: The requested playable 3D conversion extends the source’s 3×3 board to three depth layers, retaining its three-in-a-row threshold and alternating marks.
The registered grid.has_line function evaluates straight lines across all axes and diagonals of a rank-3 rectangular topology.

R is a full-session restart, not a gameplay move: the input stage must target host_command restart so it remains usable after a terminal outcome. Escape must target host_command quit. The existing input and scene documents require corresponding spatial-lift updates.

plan.topology: One bounded, cell-anchored 3×3×3 rectangular volume under rule:topology.board.
plan.source_xy_policy: Keep the source’s three columns and three rows, coordinate order, cell values, and turn sequence.
plan.neighborhood: Winning lines use straight axis, face-diagonal, and space-diagonal directions; adjacency does not determine placement legality.
plan.movement: No movement: click an unoccupied cell to place the current mark.
plan.outcomes: Three matching marks on any straight length-three spatial line win; if all 27 cells fill without a winner, draw.
plan.presentation: Use one centered orthogonal volume; retain the source’s blue X, amber O, slate cells, font, status, and instructions when updating scene_ir.
plan.input: Select a volume cell for rule:action.place; route R and Escape to host restart and quit respectively.
z_equals_one_tests: On a one-layer 3×3 variant, horizontal, vertical, and both diagonal three-mark wins match the source.
Occupied-cell and out-of-bounds placements remain rejected.
z_gt_one_tests: Three matching marks at fixed x,y across z win.
Placements after a win reject; the host can still restart.
alternatives: A single depth layer reproduces the original game but does not supply spatial play.
A larger volume changes the source’s three-cell board extents and is not selected.

checks.name: Legal placement alternates marks; occupied site rejects
Depth line wins; subsequent gameplay move rejects

One world unit is the source's 140-pixel cell pitch. The source's downward row order is represented by the negative world-Y axis.

Needs independent lifted-rule cases (all directions/neighbors/merges as applicable); not one self-generated win.
Needs state-to-asset/font/palette evidence and rendered-frame comparison; asset loading alone is insufficient.

Needs source feature inventory, menus/pause/restart/undo/AI where required; unsupported features cannot be omitted silently.
Needs measured update/render/input latency for the produced scene at target dimensions.
Needs new Source and Lift HTTP receipts with no accepted-stage cache, unchanged approved artifact hashes, and its own render capture.
